test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the highlighted words in the given sentence.

His __sudden departure left us in a difficult__ situation; it was like he suddenly took away important support from us.

options.text: hit the nail on the head

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Pulled the rug out**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Pulled the rug out"** means to suddenly and unexpectedly take away support or assistance, leaving someone in a difficult or vulnerable situation. (मदद अचानक खींच लेना)

 
 
• **Example: **The company pulled the rug out from under its employees by shutting down without any notice.
 
 
 
• The given sentence mentions a situation where someone’s sudden departure left others in difficulty, which is aptly represented by "pulled the rug out."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Pulled the rug out**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hit the nail on the head **(सही बात पर ध्यान देना): To describe or identify something exactly.

 
 
• **Example:** She hit the nail on the head when she identified the root cause of the problem.
 
 
 
• **Got his act together **(अपने कार्य व्यवस्थित करना): To get organized or improve one's performance.
 
 
• **Example:** After failing the first test, he finally got his act together and scored well on the next one.
 
 
 
• **Hit the sack **(सोने जाना): To go to bed or to sleep.
 
 
• **Example:** After a long day at work, I can't wait to hit the sack tonight.
